item.title: Musk says SpaceX landed a $40 billion debt deal — and forecasts doom for some AI rivals
item.description: SpaceX is rapidly growing an AI business that rents out access to advanced chips.
item.dc:creator: Emily Bary

item.title: ‘She’s living the dream’: My stepmother said I can buy my childhood home for $850,000. Is she taking advantage of me?
item.description: “My late father bought our house for $250,000 in the 1990s.”
item.dc:creator: Quentin Fottrell

item.title: ‘I don’t feel sorry for myself’: I’m 64 and will be renting for the rest of my life. Is that so bad?
item.description: “I married a wonderful man with a good income. He left his job due to health issues and suffered a massive stroke at 53.”
item.dc:creator: Quentin Fottrell

item.title: We stopped helping our neighbors with free home repairs and our friendship cooled. Who’s to blame?
item.description: “Last summer, they complained about needing to replace their roof. A few months later, they bought a new SUV.”
item.dc:creator: Quentin Fottrell

item.title: My father-in-law, 81, sold his $75,000 home to pay his daughter’s $50,000 debt. How can I keep him from becoming destitute?
item.description: “Nothing has been set aside for his needs.”
item.dc:creator: Quentin Fottrell

item.title: My partner of 17 years left me his $1 million home. His children are livid. Am I obliged to split it with them?
item.description: “I never paid rent, although I put about $45,000 toward a new kitchen and a roof.”
item.dc:creator: Quentin Fottrell

item.title: We have a $300,000 mortgage with a 2.75% interest rate. I want to pay it off. My husband says I’m crazy. Who’s right?
item.description: “I don’t want to enter retirement owing six figures when we have the cash to clear it.”
item.dc:creator: Quentin Fottrell

item.title: My spouse was awarded $90,000 from my 401(k) in our divorce. How is that fair?
item.description: “I retired in 2020 and subsequently went through a divorce a few years later.”
item.dc:creator: Quentin Fottrell

item.title: More than a third of S&P 500 companies are about to report earnings as market confidence cracks
item.description: “With cautious to negative market sentiment, it could be a tricky week,” one strategist says.
item.dc:creator: Bill Peters

item.title: My husband wants to sell our $1.5 million home and invest the proceeds. But this is where we raised our kids — and I can’t bear to leave.
item.description: “He wants to buy something for $600,000 now that we are empty-nesters.”
item.dc:creator: Quentin Fottrell
